dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, forming an elongated teardrop profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A minor indentation is visible on the left lateral margin relative to the central axis, otherwise smooth edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-dark grey baseline; the individual exhibits a consistent slate-grey tone typical of sub-adult phases.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, diffuse mottling across the entire dorsal surface with localized clusters of darker pixels toward the posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter grey central areas and the darker grey peripheral mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, thin, light-colored linear mark (likely a scratch or rake mark) is visible running longitudinally along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible thin longitudinal scar or rake mark located centrally on the mid-dorsal plane.
